An '''unidentified Aqualish technician''' served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]].

==Biography==
[[File:SkytopAqualishTech-DotD.png|thumb|left|200px|The tech blocks his screen from R2-D2]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] was working on a bank of equipment in Skytop Station when [[Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] toured the newly completed [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]].<ref name="Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref> Later that year, following the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was brought to the station by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]]. The tech attempted to block his work station screen from the prying sensors of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]. He helped [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to defend the station when the Jedi [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|attacked it]] and died when the station was destroyed.<ref name="Duel">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>
